title: Irreducible successive singular-vector quotients for integer-spin d=1 complex conformal Galilei algebras at arbitrary D-weight and nonzero P_ell weight
author: Naruhiko Aizawa; Radhakrishnan Chandrashekar; Jambulingam Segar
work: Lowest Weight Representations, Singular Vectors and Invariant Equations for a Class of Conformal Galilei Algebras
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 002, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.002; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author proof constructs a chain of subsingular-vector quotients for every integer spin and computes the graded Shapovalov determinants in those quotients. A final argument excludes singular vectors at every remaining level, giving an infinite-dimensional irreducible module with an explicit two-generator PBW basis.

source_check.note: Only the complete original nonzero-p branch of Theorem 1 is selected; the zero-p branch is excluded without alteration, keeping the original enclosing theorem/list boundaries. All algebra/Verma/Shapovalov definitions and the full spin-one determinant proof are retained. For every integer spin ell>=2, all successive singular/subsingular quotient constructions, exact quotient PBW bases, graded determinant induction, unique next singular-vector calculation and final exclusion at every remaining level are supplied together as one irreducible-module outcome. Standard PBW and lowest-weight/submodule principles remain background. Original matrix-entry and superscript notation are preserved. No zero-p/sl2 conclusion or invariant-PDE family is selected. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: Complete nonzero-p proof in Section6.1 and determinant support in Section3 read. For spin ell>=2 the module is the successive quotient described in Lemma5, with P_(ell-a)u0=((ell+2)...(ell+a))/(a!p^(a-1)(ell+1)^(a-1)) P_(ell-1)^a u0 for2<=a<=ell and basis H^k P_(ell-1)^m u0. Lemmas3-5 construct and control every quotient and the final page16 argument excludes all higher-level singular vectors. Spin1 uses the full determinant formula. Zero-p/sl2 branches and invariant PDE families are excluded.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Only the nonzero-p branch of Theorem1: complex Lie algebra g_ell with d=1 and positive integer ell, arbitrary lowest D-weight delta, nonzero P_ell-weight p. The spin1 Verma module and the explicit successive quotient for ell>=2 are irreducible; the latter has basis H^k P_(ell-1)^m u0 for k,m>=0. No zero-p conclusion selected.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: The text calls each interim submodule the largest submodule while subsequently taking further quotients. The selected module is fixed by the explicit successive construction and final Lemma5 relations, not by treating any interim quotient as already irreducible. Original pages are unchanged.
